memories.action: On Ubuntu toolchains gcc passes --as-needed, so list libraries after the objects: $(CC) -shared -o $@ $(OBJS) $(LDLIBS). A pthread_create undefined reference means LDLIBS came first.
memories.applicability: Link errors with undefined references while building libfrob.so.

memories.action: Do not use epoll_pwait2 in frobd: customers run RHEL 7 (kernel 3.10) where it returns ENOSYS. Keep epoll_wait with millisecond timeouts, rounding up.
memories.applicability: Changing the event loop or timeout precision in frobd net.c.
